Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 1, 2026

Operator and scope

Moran Ohana, operating as Ohana Labs, in Israel, is responsible for the information described here. Contact: ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com. This notice covers 1on1, optional support correspondence and its public document pages.

The app has no player accounts, gameplay backend, cloud synchronization, chat, purchases or separate analytics/crash-reporting service. All games work offline. The development build includes optional Google test-ad services; production advertising is currently disabled.

Information kept on your device

The app stores sound, vibration, rotation and language choices, game difficulty/options, named session scores and history, and which seat should open next. It also stores the accepted Terms/Privacy versions, acceptance time and selected language. These records support local play and remember your choices; they are not uploaded to Ohana Labs.

You do not need to provide a name, email, birthdate, exact age or other identifying details to play. Session names are optional local labels; avoid putting sensitive or identifying information in them. There is no remote account for us to delete.

Google advertising and privacy requests

After the local legal step, a mobile development build can contact Google AdMob and User Messaging Platform (UMP) to refresh privacy information, initialize and preload a test ad. Requests can occur before an ad is visible and even if no ad is ultimately shown. A legal acknowledgment is not advertising consent.

Google may receive an IP address and infer a broad location, app/ad interactions, device/app identifiers and diagnostic information to deliver and measure ads, maintain services and prevent fraud. Non-personalized or test ads do not mean anonymous processing or no device storage. We do not receive a player-level advertising profile from Google.

Requests use child-directed and under-age treatment, G-rated content and non-personalized settings. Android ad-identifier and Privacy Sandbox permissions are removed, and no ATT tracking prompt is made on iOS. These controls reduce processing; they do not eliminate all information handling. No mediation adapter SDKs are added.

UMP is asked to apply under-age treatment. The app does not ask a child to provide advertising consent; an update failure or unexpected consent requirement leaves ads unavailable for that visit. Google explains its practices at https://policies.google.com/privacy and https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads. Live advertising requires a separate release review and any additional notices/permissions required by law.

Children and guardian involvement

1on1 is designed for family play, including children around age five and older. All players receive the same restricted advertising configuration; no age or birthdate is collected to unlock adult advertising. A parent or guardian should review the notice and approve use for a child who cannot independently agree.

We do not seek identifying information from children. For a child's support request or concern about information a child has sent, a parent or guardian should contact ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com and avoid including the child's name, contact details or sensitive information. We will address appropriate requests under applicable law.

Optional support email

If you email support, we receive your email address, message and any attachments you choose to send. Providing these is voluntary, not a legal obligation; without contact information we may be unable to reply. We use the information to handle your request, troubleshoot and protect legitimate rights, not for behavioral advertising. Do not send passwords, payment details or sensitive information.

Support is handled through Gmail/Google. Access is limited to the operator and providers needed to handle correspondence, or disclosure required by law. We aim to delete or anonymize closed support correspondence within 12 months, unless an unresolved matter or legal duty requires longer. We do not sell support correspondence.

External services, sharing and international processing

Google processes advertising/privacy requests and email under its applicable terms and policies. Its infrastructure may be outside Israel and your country. Advertising-related processing can involve disclosure to Google and its permitted service providers; it is not the same as local-only game storage. Applicable transfer safeguards and legal requirements must be respected.

If you choose to open our public pages, GitHub Pages may process IP addresses, browser details and request logs for hosting/security, potentially outside your country. Our pages add no analytics, advertising, cookies, third-party fonts or scripts. See https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement. An offline copy is available in the app.

Apple and Google process store downloads, installations and optional device diagnostics under their own policies. Store reviews are public. We may receive aggregate store statistics and developer diagnostic reports when the device owner enables them; there is no separate in-app crash-reporting service.

Retention, deletion and device backups

Local settings, sessions and the legal receipt remain until removed from app storage. Clear app data through the operating system or delete the app to remove its local data; deleting a score session is not the same as deleting all data. Ohana Labs cannot remotely access, restore or erase records that exist only on your device.

The operating system may make device/cloud backups according to your settings. Android app backup is disabled in this build, but system/device behavior can vary. Existing backups and third-party Google records are not erased by a local app reset or uninstall; manage them through the relevant provider. Google applies its own retention rules to information it receives.

Your choices, rights and security

The app does not require identifying details or an online account to play. You can play without a connection. A Terms agreement and Privacy acknowledgment are required to enter gameplay; they do not authorize additional advertising, storage or tracking beyond what law permits. If the legal receipt cannot be saved, gameplay remains locked until retry succeeds.

For information you send to us, you may request access or correction and, where applicable law provides, deletion or other rights by emailing ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com. We may ask for proportionate information to verify the request. We cannot grant access to Google-held advertising data; use Google's privacy controls or contact Google. No device or communication method is guaranteed secure.

Changes and contact

We update this notice when practices change, including before enabling live ads, and obtain additional consent where legally required. A new document version requires a new local acknowledgment. In-app documents and generated public pages share the same version. Contact: ohana.ai.apps@gmail.com.
